newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q1 MUTUAL FUND ASSETS UP TO FIM 14.6 BLN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q1 MUTUAL FUND ASSETS UP TO FIM 14.6 BLN.

text.p: Assets in Finnish mutual funds increased to 14.6 billion markka by end-March from 11.6 billion at end-1996, the association of Finnish mutual funds said on Thursday.
"We have had a record first quarter," Mikko Savikko, managing director of the association told a news conference.
"But we expect things to mellow out a bit, and depending on the market situation things couldpick-up again in the autumn," he added.
The asscocition repeated its earlier forecast that assests in mutual funds would rise to 20 billion markka by end-1997.
The return on a one-year investment in stock funds was 52.7 percent in March, 33.9 percent for mutual funds and 7.6 percent for interest rate funds, the association said.
